Scope from triage, and ⛔ **no wider**: an **opt-in `--unread-report` flag** printing the per-document `(calls, receivers)` pairs and site lists **the run already computes**. ⛔ No verdict change, ⛔ no exit-code change, same *"visibility, not a verdict"* register. ⛔ **Not** a widening of what the gate types — #9870's option D stays declined pending its census.

⭐ **The deliverable includes a checksum property as a self-test**: the per-document rows must **sum to the printed scalars**, so the breakdown can never drift from the totals. That is the part that makes this more than a convenience flag.

⚠️ This card exists because of a transcription error **I made**: card #10368 quoted `47 sites / 18 receivers` when the gate yields `30 / 17` — `47` is `derivedReceivers`, a whole-repo scalar printed one line above `NOT read:`. The card's own framing is that the gate *invites* that mistake by printing only whole-repo scalars where a per-document number is needed. Your flag is the fix for the invitation, not for my slip.

## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` — propose wording in the report.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree of the repo.
- ⚠️ **A pipe swallows the exit code.** Capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ ⭐ **#10853, measured today: `pnpm --filter <name>` with a name that does not exist prints `No projects matched the filters` and EXITS 0** — a whole verification round can read as green while nothing ran. Verify your filter matched; a negative control (`--filter @objectstack/definitely-not-a-package`) is the cheap way.
- ⚠️ **The shared checkout at `/home/user/objectstack` is STALE.** Measure against `origin/main` or your own worktree — never the shared tree. That mistake bit this seat twice today.
- ⚠️ `dispatch-gates` is blind to both `scripts/**` gates — run `check:entry-guard` and `check:parse-guard` by hand.
- ⚠️ Apply labels **additively** (`POST /issues/N/labels`), never a whole-set PUT, and read back after the size labeler runs.
- ⚠️ `main` has `Console Pin Gate` red for a known unrelated cross-repo reason (#10856) — **non-blocking**, ⛔ not yours, ⛔ not a signal about your change.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.
